RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Accusing the panel of bias based solely on its demographic composition is unsubstantiated and would severely damage your professional reputation. For a "Head of" role, executive leadership, stakeholder management, and regulatory affairs often outweigh purely technical or statistical depth, which explains why the bank prioritized her background.

A two-week delay for written feedback is standard in corporate HR. Raising gender without concrete evidence would burn industry bridges and end further dialogue. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive developmental feedback to understand which competencies set the successful candidate apart.
